description: Vanilla MinimalGPT+RoPE (exp328 architecture) at bs=96 8K steps. Compute-matched and bs-matched fair comparison vs exp608 (LUT-LM SoTA bs=96 8K = 1.2180). Direct test of LUT-LM-vs-vanilla at fixed compute + bs. n_steps=8000 unchanged, total_batch_size 8192 -> 49152 (6x). Native phys bs=96 (vanilla is small enough at 23.2M params to fit). Reference points: exp328 vanilla bs=16 8K = 1.3882 (compute=65.5M tokens); exp416 vanilla bs=16 24K = 1.2530 (196M tokens, 0.5x exp608 compute); exp442 vanilla bs=48 24K = 1.1585 (590M tokens, 1.5x exp608). exp609 at 393M tokens matches exp608 exactly. If exp609 < 1.2180: vanilla still wins at matched compute. If exp609 > 1.2180: LUT-LM cleanly beats at matched compute (first time).
